changelog.title: Dark Retro & Archive Status Fix
items: Darkened the Game Boy and SNES-inspired palette while keeping the same retro-console theme
Archived Sprite variants now show explicit Owned, Missing, and Mastered read-only status instead of disabled buttons
Removed the misleading archived check and star controls that could make missing variants look collected
Archived seasons remain fully view-only

changelog.title: Retro Console Theme & Locked Archives
items: Redesigned SpriteDex with Game Boy-inspired green screens and SNES-inspired shell and button colors
Moved the season selector into Settings and simplified the labels to Current season and Archived season
Archived season Sprites are now view-only and cannot have ownership, mastery, or favorites changed
Updated the app icon and bottom navigation icons with a retro pixel-game look
Automatic Sprite syncing now updates only the current season so archived season databases stay frozen

changelog.title: Season Archives & Override
items: Split SpriteDex into Chapter 7 Season 4 and Chapter 7 Season 3 collections
Season 4 is the default view; Season 3 is preserved as an archived collection
Added the 12 Season 4 launch Sprites and their Gold and Cheat Master variants
Missing counts now follow the selected season so retired Season 3 entries do not pollute the current hunt
Updated automatic Sprite syncing to recognize Cheat Master variants and assign new releases to the current season

changelog.title: Automatic Sprite Database Sync
items: SpriteDex now downloads the newest hosted Sprite list whenever the app opens
New Sprite entries appear without installing a new app version
Added Sprite database status and Sync Sprite List Now to About
Moved Export Backup and Import Backup out of Family and into About
Added a daily GitHub Action that checks Fortnite.GG for released Sprite entries

changelog.title: Settings and Update Center
items: Added a Settings & About tab with installed and latest version numbers
Added Check Again, Update Now, and Force Refresh controls
Added an update badge to the About navigation button
Added collection, collector, data date, and backup status details
Automatic launch checks now run silently instead of interrupting the app

changelog.title: Backup and Restore
items: Added Export Backup to the Family tab
Added Import Backup to restore data on another SpriteDex installation
Backups include collection ownership, mastery, favorites, collector details, and family snapshots
Imports are validated and require confirmation before replacing local data

changelog.title: Persistent Home Screen Storage
items: Home Screen launches now use one permanent SpriteDex URL
Removed versioned start URLs from the web app manifest
Added an IndexedDB mirror of collection and family data
Existing local data automatically migrates into the storage mirror
Updates use a temporary refresh address and return to the permanent URL

changelog.title: Smart Updates and Mastery Filters
items: Added automatic version checks with Update Now and Later
Update reloads the newest files while preserving saved collection data
Added Mastered and Not mastered Collection filters
Replaced the Home Screen icon with the new cyan F design

changelog.title: First-Launch Onboarding
items: New devices now ask for a collector name
Existing collectors skip onboarding and keep saved data
Collector names are trimmed and capitalized
Names must be 2 to 20 characters
Family QR automatically uses the device collector name
